mutants.description: Bypass the public RepairAndImport decision. The positive row must invoke the callback and produce the fixed closed four-face output; the ordinary ImportWithoutRepair control remains distinct.
Discard centroid-based color resampling after repair. The four-face repaired output samples a red and a blue UV plateau, so the positive row must retain both independent expected colors.

Ignore cancellation immediately after the public repair callback. The cancellation row must return false and must stop before the public Color clustering progress stage; removing this guard reaches that stage and fails the ordinary progress assertion.
